poc_plan: Objective: validate Dedicated latency/throughput and canary + fallback routing. Scope: 2-week test on dedicated GPU pool (reserved nodes, p3-equivalent), run production prompt mix against dedicated with 10% canary traffic for first 3 days, then ramp to 50% if SLA met. Model variants: primary = rwi-7b-fp16, fallback variant = rwi-7b-quant8 for low-latency paths. Routing/fallback: smart router sends requests by policy (latency-sensitive -> quantized variant, quality-critical -> fp16). Failover: region failover from us-east -> us-west with automatic routing if average p90 latency > 700ms or error rate > 2% for 3 consecutive minutes. Rollback: auto rollback to Hosted API for affected routes if Dedicated error rate spike or infra incident; manual rollback steps documented. Success criteria: median latency < 150ms for search paths, p95 < 350ms, error rate < 0.5%, throughput sustained at 120 reqs/s with <10% tail latency degradation.
sales_notes: Customer is mid-market product analytics vendor with embedded help and search features.
